hero.title: The whole gospel transforming the whole person and whole community
hero.description: Explore Africa, understand communities, and measure transformation — a data intelligence platform for Possibilities Africa.

networkFlow.title: From continent to community — pastor-led transformation
networkFlow.description: Possibilities Africa coordinates ministry from the continental level through countries, catchment areas, and local communities — reaching households through pastor-led networks.

developmentTopics.title: Holistic transformation across Africa
developmentTopics.description: Pastor-led programmes addressing leadership, discipleship, livelihoods, youth, and citizenship — tracked from continent to community.

topics.title: Transformational Leadership
topics.summary: Equipping pastor leaders to coordinate holistic community transformation across catchments.
topics.description: Pastor leaders are the backbone of the PA network. Through structured training, mentorship, and the Triple-A model — Awareness, Ability, Action — leaders guide communities through a two-year transformation journey with measurable leadership scores.

topics.title: Discipleship
topics.summary: Shalom groups of 30–50 leaders driving discipleship and social cohesion in every community.
topics.description: Each community develops Shalom groups that deepen faith, build cohesion, and mobilise local initiative. Discipleship programmes connect pastors, lay leaders, and households in sustained spiritual formation.

topics.title: Economic Productivity
topics.summary: Person-to-person skill transfer, cooperatives, and livelihood programmes lifting household income.
topics.description: Economic Productivity CHIP groups teach practical skills — baking, farming, small business — with person-to-person replication across communities. Income activities and cooperative models are tracked at catchment and country level.

topics.title: Youth Mentoring
topics.summary: Investing in the next generation through pastor-led youth mentorship networks.
topics.description: Youth mentoring connects young people with pastor leaders and community role models. Programmes focus on character, skills, and civic participation — building a pipeline of leaders for tomorrow's communities.

topics.title: Responsible Citizenship
topics.summary: Community-led water, agriculture, and infrastructure projects owned by local people.
topics.description: Responsible Citizenship mobilises communities to plan and build their own assets — trench dams, irrigation, health outreaches. Pastor-Planned Projects (PPPs) exemplify local ownership and resource mobilization.

topics.title: Measuring Transformation
topics.summary: Real-time dashboards tracking progress from Africa to individual communities.
topics.description: The Transformation Intelligence platform connects field tracking data to institutional dashboards — CBC index, readiness levels, growth trends, and scorecards. Decision-makers see exactly where progress is accelerating or needs support.

impactOverview.title: Impact at a glance
impactOverview.description: Key transformation metrics across the PA network. Aligned with how PA works — catchments, Shalom groups, and the 2-year journey.
